semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company supplies high-purity PFA materials which are relevant for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Zhejiang Yonghe Refrigerant Co., Ltd. specializes in the fluorochemical industry, providing high-purity PFA materials essential for semiconductor applications. With over 20 years of experience, the company supports various sectors including PV manufacturing consumables.

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Quzhou, Zhejiang, and has multiple subsidiaries across various provinces.
